content:
The creative power of the imagination is one of the greatest tools humans possess. Unlike other species that adapt to their environment, humans use imagination to adapt the environment to themselves. This distinct ability has led to the development of complex societies, technologies, and arts. However, imagination is a double-edged sword; while it creates wonders, it can also conjure scenarios of doom that do not exist, leading to anxiety and fear.

In the modern era, the digital landscape has become a new frontier for the imagination. Virtual realities allow people to inhabit worlds that were previously only accessible through dreams. Yet, sociologists warn that excessive immersion in these fabricated realities may dull our ability to deal with the tangible challenges of the physical world.

questions.q: According to the passage, what distinguishes humans from other species?
opts: The ability to dream while sleeping
The capacity to adapt the environment to their needs
The physical strength to build complex societies
The ability to survive in digital landscapes

questions.q: The phrase 'double-edged sword' implies that imagination...
opts: Has both beneficial and detrimental aspects
Can only be used by skilled artists

questions.q: What warning do sociologists give regarding virtual reality?
opts: It will replace physical reality entirely
It is too expensive for the average person
It might weaken coping mechanisms for real-world problems

questions.q: A suitable title for this passage would be:
opts: The Human Imagination: Power and Peril
